Source contracts: startup.sh

startup.sh

Shell · Tier B

Launch the Agent API and optional manual/diagnostic sidecars.

Usage

Start the controller from its installed repository environment; Gateway/model services are separate.

Inputs

--config, --data-dir, --host, --port, --manual-port, --reload and --https; AOR_*

Side effects

Loads bootstrap configuration, starts Uvicorn processes and may prepare configured HTTPS state. Uses the root .venv; does not update remote Gateway installations.

Cleanup

The shared web-bundle supervisor owns child termination and restart.
